dct_description_sm: Montserrat administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset. The date that these administrative boundaries were established is unknown. NOTE: See COD-PS caveat about displacement due to volcanic activity. This COD-AB has NOT been reviewed for accuracy and necessary changes in the last 12 months. Sourced from www.gadm.org Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID. This COD-AB is suitable for database or GIS linkage to the Montserrat [COD-PS](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-msr). As this is an island country, no edge-matched (COD-EM) version of this COD-AB is required. Please see the [COD Portal](https://cod.unocha.org/). Administrative level 1 contains 3 feature(s). The normal administrative level 1 feature type is ""Parish"". Recommended cartographic projection: North America Albers Equal Area Conic This metadata was last updated on January 9, 2025.
